chunks: The only reason you have to hate us is that we believed in the signs of our Lord as they came to us. O our Lord, give us sufficient endurance that we may die submitting (to You).

key_terms.بِآيَاتِ رَبِّنَا: In the signs of our Lord
key_terms.تَنْقِمُ: You blame or hold against us

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication 'Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the virtue of *Sabr* (patient endurance) as a prerequisite for a righteous death (*Husn al-Khatimah*), linking the believers' steadfastness to the ultimate goal of submission. It underscores the contrast between the arrogance of the oppressor and the humble reliance of the faithful, a theme central to the narrative of the Prophets in Surah Al-A'raf.
